#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    auto build_segment_tree = [](int size) {
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i >= size * 2) {
                return vector<long long>(i, 0);
            }
            i *= 2;
        }
    };

    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;

    auto prime_factors = [](long long n) {
        vector<long long> factors;
        for (long long i = 2; i * i <= n; ++i) {
            while (n % i == 0) {
                factors.push_back(i);
                n /= i;
            }
            if (n == 1) break;
        }
        if (n != 1) factors.push_back(n);
        return factors;
    };

    auto euler_phi = [&](long long n) {
        set<long long> p_factors(prime_factors(n).begin(), prime_factors(n).end());
        long long result = n;
        for (auto p : p_factors) {
            result = result * (p - 1) / p;
        }
        return result;
    };

    auto factorial_range = [&](long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
        long long res = 1;
        for (long long i = a + 1; i <= b; ++i) {
            res = (res * i) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    };

    long long phi_value = euler_phi(mod);
    int max_len = n + 5;
    vector<long long> fact(max_len + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_len; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }

    if (n <= 3) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<long long> dp(2000, 0);
    dp[0] = 1; dp[1] = 2; dp[2] = 2; dp[3] = 1;

    auto tree = build_segment_tree(2005);
    vector<long long> seg_tree = tree;

    auto set_value = [&](int i, long long val) {
        int idx = i + (int)seg_tree.size() / 2;
        seg_tree[idx] = val;
        idx /= 2;
        while (idx > 0) {
            seg_tree[idx] = seg_tree[2 * idx] + seg_tree[2 * idx + 1];
            idx /= 2;
        }
    };

    auto range_sum = [&](int s, int t) {
        s += (int)seg_tree.size() / 2;
        t += (int)seg_tree.size() / 2;
        long long total = 0;
        while (s <= t) {
            if (s % 2 == 0) {
                s /= 2;
            } else {
                total += seg_tree[s];
                s = (s + 1) / 2;
            }
            if (t % 2 == 1) {
                total += seg_tree[t];
                t = (t - 1) / 2;
            } else {
                t /= 2;
            }
        }
        return total;
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
        set_value(i, dp[i]);
    }

    int m = 3;
    long long total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; ++i) {
        vector<long long> prev_dp = dp;
        long long partial_sum = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j <= i + 2; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; ++k) {
                long long sum_val = range_sum(j + k + 1, 2004);
                partial_sum = (partial_sum + sum_val * prev_dp[k - 1]) % mod;
                dp[j + k] = (dp[j + k] + prev_dp[k - 1]) % mod;
                set_value(j + k, dp[j + k]);
            }
        }
        m += i + 3;
        long long factor = factorial_range(i + 4, n, mod);
        total = (total + factor * partial_sum) % mod;
    }
    cout << total << "\n";

    return 0;
}
